symptom: New feature pre-delivery Electron walk: first continuous trim movement stops at 0.4s instead of 3s; independent review also identified keyboard, readonly and source identity gaps.
direct_cause: Seeking temporarily lowers readyState. The new panel used frame readiness to disable native handles during an active pointer drag.
class_root: Editing intent, source identity and decoded-frame readiness need separate owners and lifetimes.
affected_population: All source-card trim handle drags and source video switches in this new feature
internal_only_reason: Application session ownership; no dependency change. Native media readiness is used as observed in real Electron.
invariants: A seek never disables the gesture that requested it.
Confirm waits for frame readiness; selection editing only requires metadata.
Readonly session cannot capture; source identity change replaces the session.
Only the original guarded source video renders during trimming.

door_reduction.why_not: Four surfaces have distinct input/render jobs but share one per-source session; merging the surfaces would reintroduce duplicate preview or unrelated canvas updates.

generality_proof: All original-card edit controls share the keyed session; selection changes synchronously update its range reference and seek the guarded source. Frame readiness only gates frame capture and final trim submission.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Per-source editing ownership, readonly capture authorization and synchronous seek intent.
Metadata-backed selection edits remain enabled through seeks; no second preview.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Continuous pointer drag and keyboard in real Electron walks.
Seek slider stays metadata-enabled; exact frame capture walks exercise the source player.

recurrence.reason: Every video seek may lower decoded readiness on another input/device.

prevention.invariant: Each editable source owns one session; edit intent is independent of decode readiness.
prevention.failure_mode: No media metadata means no editing; unavailable current frame blocks capture and submission, not ongoing seeks.
prevention.strategy: Key the provider to node/source identity, gate writes by explicit writable capability, keep selection in the session, and distinguish metadata from frame readiness.

legacy_paths.rationale: Delete duplicate-preview timeline adapter; all edit preview uses the original card.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No third-party upgrade controls application session/readiness policy.

migration: No persisted data format changes; sessions are transient and dispose on source change.
residual_risks: Windows and packaged release unverified. macOS production walks: trim 9/9 per locale; frame capture 8/8 per locale. Generic stack-drag scenario aborted from an undefined destination in its harness.
